plainText:
Freddy O'Martian (Japanese: タケミツ Takemitsu) is a recurring character in . He is an announcer who hosts various throughout the Unova region and the Decolore Islands. He also goes by the nickname "The Scoop".

==History==
Freddy first appeared from Reunion Battles In Nimbasa! to Club Battle Finale: A Hero's Outcome!. He was the co-announcer for the Club Battle tournament, working alongside the Don George of Nimbasa Town. 

From The Clubsplosion Begins! to Commanding the Clubsplosion Crown!, Freddy was the co-announcer for the Clubsplosion. He once again worked alongside a Don George, this time the one from Ambiga Town.

From Jostling for the Junior Cup! to Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure!, Freddy was the co-host of the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup. This time, he provided commentary for the competition alongside Alder.

From Curtain Up, Unova League! to A Unova League Evolution!, Freddy hosted the Vertress Conference. At the commencement of the opening ceremonies, he entered the stadium by parachuting from a helicopter.

He reappeared for the final time in Crowning the Scalchop King!, where he hosted the Scalchop King Competition at Scalchop Island in the Decolore Islands.

==Character==
Freddy appears to be the go-to guy when it comes to hosting tournaments. He has acted as the announcer for several during Pokémon the Series: Black & White, from small ones such as 's Clubsplosion, to major events that attract a large group of s, such as Unova's , the Vertress Conference.

He is very enthusiastic and his style is similar to that of a . He seems to be friends with Don George.
